name: Tirnach Cabinet 29 Original
description: This listing is a firn-probe calibration bench listed with accuracy class 1.94 percent, operating temperature -23 degrees Celsius, sampling rate 912.2 hertz. Its remaining stated figures are calibration interval 29 months, unit price set after acceptance, mounting fixed base. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
